Ian Kamau.bio: Ian Kamau is a Toronto-based Canadian hip-hop and spoken-word artist, writer and designer. Active in Toronto's rap community since the early 2000s, his catalogue includes the album One Day Soon and collaborations with Canadian artists including k-os and Shad.

Lex Leosis.bio: Lex Leosis is a Toronto-raised Canadian rapper known for her solo work and her earlier role in the Toronto hip-hop group The Sorority. Her music combines technically agile rap with jazz, funk, pop and hip-hop influences.

NorthSideBenji.bio: NorthSideBenji is a Brampton-born, Toronto-area Canadian rapper known for melodic street rap and projects including Caviar Dreams and The Extravagant Collection. He emerged from the GTA scene and has collaborated extensively with Toronto artists including Houdini and DJ Charlie B.

Sunglaciers.bio: Sunglaciers are a Calgary, Alberta post-punk and psych-pop band whose music blends indie rock, electronic textures and experimental pop. Their releases include Subterranea, Regular Nature and Spiritual Content.

Sebastien Grainger.bio: Sebastien Grainger is a Mississauga-born Canadian singer, songwriter, drummer and multi-instrumentalist best known as the vocalist and drummer of Toronto dance-punk duo Death from Above 1979. He has also released music as a solo artist and with Sebastien Grainger and the Mountains.
